description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetStreamVariable, which implements a method to retrieve the contents of a stream variable by reading its contents from a file.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetStreamVariable
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to get the contents of a stream variable, used internally within Smarty templates.

methods.name: getStreamVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a stream variable by reading a file specified by the variable name.
